headline: Grumpy Walrus sold ~5,640 ASCEND (~6,349 ADA) in two clips (2:24 PM ~640 / ~723 ADA, 4:06 PM ~5,000 / ~5,626 ADA), likely pulled COCK LP again (~824 ADA + ~193.6k COCK), bought ~2.73M MEPE (~1.77k ADA), ~640 NIGHT, ~15.9k COCK, and sent ~3.1k ADA outside; net ADA ~+2,093; ASCEND bag ~320.0k. WED failed the SW-01 gate (no DEX pool at launch+24h); TECHMAGE status set to failed_gate (still no pool). CHRLS new swarm Pass + SW-01 pending_gate (repeat early buyer + sniper full exit). ASCEND side ~1.062M (~41.6% above line), COCK ~136.6k (9.0% under). Nothing passes k/y; no SW-01 ticket.
learned: Lessons: an ASCEND whale_move with a large ADA leg often pairs with same-window MEPE buys and an outside ADA send — net ADA is much smaller than the sell notional, so always recompute the full window before calling it a cash-out.
